property.otherRooms: Home office, formal dining room, living room, laundry room
property.parking: Single-car attached garage, driveway for two more cars
property.legalDescription: Single-family detached dwelling with home office, formal dining room and laundry room

terms.targetSettlement: Ideally Dec 12, 2026. Anywhere from 45 to 60 days after acceptance works.
terms.included: Refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer, dryer, all window treatments, garden shed
terms.excluded: Dining room chandelier (her mother's). She will put up a standard fixture in its place.
terms.homeWarranty: Will add a one-year warranty if a buyer asks

disclosures.detail: Water after heavy rain in 2021. Sump pump installed 2021, dry since.
All included appliances in working order

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $350,000.
- Under $340,000: she declines politely and does not counter.
- $340,000 to $349,999: she counters at $358,000.
- $350,000 or more with clean terms: she accepts.
- Accepts mortgage, inspection, appraisal, termite and radon contingencies. Will not accept a contingency on the sale of the buyer's home.
- Prefers a repair credit of up to $3,000 over doing repairs herself.
- An offer with a pre-approval letter gets her attention first.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The seller has countered at $358,000. She's flexible on the settlement date if that helps you."
- "She'd prefer to give a repair credit rather than have work done before settlement."
- "She's asked me to pass along her planting notes for the garden. She'd like the new owners to have them."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- Water heater is from 2014.
- Basement took on water after heavy rain in 2021. A sump pump was installed that year and it has been dry since.
- Roof replaced in 2017. Furnace and central air replaced in 2019.
- Lead paint disclosure not needed, built 1994.

Seller will put up a standard light fixture in place of the dining room chandelier, which she is keeping.

listings.description: Bungalow with open kitchen and lounge, covered front porch and long private driveway. Sold as-is. Rooms: Open kitchen and lounge, covered front porch.
listings.showingInstructions: Two hours’ notice. No lockbox. Seller lets buyers in and waits on the porch.

property.otherRooms: Open kitchen and lounge, covered front porch
property.parking: Detached two-car garage, long private driveway
property.heating: Oil-fired furnace. Indoor oil tank in the utility room, installed 2015.
property.utilities: About $260 per month, including heating oil
property.legalDescription: Bungalow with open kitchen and lounge, covered front porch and long private driveway. Sold as-is.

terms.included: Refrigerator, range, washer, the workbench and shelving in the garage
terms.excluded: His recliner and the porch rocking chairs
terms.financingAccepted: Cash or conventional preferred. Wary of FHA, because the appraiser may ask for repairs he won't make.

disclosures.detail: Asphalt shingle, from 2009. Nearing the end of its life.
No central air. Window units only.
Some original galvanized pipe. Part replaced in 2012.
Built 1956. No known lead paint and no reports.
Indoor oil tank in the utility room, installed 2015. No buried tanks known.
Original wood windows. Garage door sticks in cold weather.

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $175,000.
- Under $165,000: he declines.
- $165,000 to $174,999: he counters at $182,500.
- $175,000 or more: he accepts.
- Speed matters more than price. He would take $180,000 cash with a 30-day settlement over $186,000 with a 60-day settlement.
- Buyers may inspect, but for information only. No repairs and no credits.
- Will not accept a contingency on the sale of the buyer's home.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The seller is selling the home as-is. You're welcome to inspect, but he won't be making repairs or giving credits."
- "He's countered at $182,500. He's told me a quick settlement matters more to him than squeezing out the last dollar."
- "He's leaving his workbench and shelving in the garage for whoever buys it."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- Roof is from 2009.
- Original wood windows.
- Oil furnace with an indoor oil tank in the utility room, from 2015. No central air.
- Some older galvanized plumbing. Part of it was replaced in 2012.
- Never tested for radon.
- Garage door sticks in cold weather.
- Built before 1978, so the lead paint disclosure is required. He knows of no lead paint and has no reports.

Property is sold as-is. Seller will not make repairs or give credits.

listings.description: Modern two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with in-ground pool, covered cabana and patio. Rooms: Home office, double-height living room, kitchen with centre island, dining area, sitting room, upstairs open landing. Covered cabana, covered patio, fenced backyard. In-ground, heated. Heater replaced 2024. Whispering Pines, gated. Every home in the community shares the address 601 Cardinal Court.
listings.showingInstructions: Four hours’ notice. The family leaves during showings. Agent meets buyers at the community gate.

property.otherRooms: Home office, double-height living room, kitchen with centre island, dining area, sitting room, upstairs open landing
property.parking: Garage parking for three vehicles (a double and a single garage)
property.heating: Natural gas forced air, two zones
property.utilities: About $520 per month, including pool heating in summer
property.legalDescription: Modern two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with in-ground pool, covered cabana and patio

ownership.vesting: Married couple, tenants by the entirety

terms.included: Refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer, dryer, pool equipment and cover, cabana lounge chairs, TV wall mount
terms.excluded: Living room TV and all indoor furniture, unless a buyer negotiates for it
terms.leasedItems: None. The pool heater is owned.
terms.financingAccepted: Any, as long as the offer includes a pre-approval letter or proof of funds

disclosures.detail: Natural gas forced air, two zones, 2019
Tested at completion in 2019, below the action level
In-ground heated pool. Heater replaced 2024. Hairline cosmetic crack in the pool deck.
Community gate reader is sometimes slow (HOA matter)
Whispering Pines HOA, $210 per month. Covers gate, roads and snow removal.

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $690,000.
- Under $660,000: they decline.
- $660,000 to $689,999: they counter at $705,000. They counter once only. After that they ask for best and final offers.
- $690,000 or more, able to settle by Dec 15: they accept.
- A buyer who can settle by Dec 15 wins over a slightly higher offer that settles later.
- Accept mortgage, inspection and appraisal contingencies with 10-day deadlines. Will not accept a contingency on the sale of the buyer's home.
- No credit for the single bathroom. They say it is already reflected in the price.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The sellers need to settle by December 15th. That date is firm, so an offer that meets it will be taken very seriously."
- "They've countered at $705,000. They've told me this is their one counter, so please treat your reply as your best offer."
- "They'd like a pre-approval letter with any offer before they review it."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- One bathroom only.
- Pool heater replaced in 2024.
- Hairline crack in the pool deck. It is cosmetic.
- The community gate reader is sometimes slow. That is an HOA matter.
- Lead paint disclosure not needed, built 2019.

The home has one bathroom. The HOA resale certificate has been ordered for the buyer.

listings.description: Modern two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with double-height dining room, upstairs loft and games room, covered front patio and private backyard. Rooms: Double-height dining room with floor-to-ceiling windows, open kitchen with centre island, lounge, upstairs loft and games room. Private backyard, covered front patio. Whispering Pines, gated.
listings.showingInstructions: 24 hours' notice. The owners are usually at the restaurants. Hameed meets buyers at the community gate.

property.otherRooms: Double-height dining room with floor-to-ceiling windows, open kitchen with centre island, lounge, upstairs loft and games room
property.parking: Oversized garage that fits three vehicles
property.heating: Natural gas forced air, two zones
property.cooling: Central air, two zones. Upstairs compressor replaced in 2023.
property.hoa: $210 per month. Covers the gate, private roads and snow removal.
property.legalDescription: Modern two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with double-height dining room, upstairs loft and games room, covered front patio and private backyard

ownership.vesting: Jointly, as a married couple (tenants by the entirety)

terms.targetSettlement: 60 to 75 days after acceptance, ideally Jan 15, 2027, when their condo is finished
terms.included: Refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer, dryer, the pool table in the games room, patio chairs
terms.excluded: Framed artwork and the living room TV
terms.financingAccepted: Any, with a pre-approval letter or proof of funds

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $760,000.
- Under $730,000: they decline but stay friendly, and invite a better offer.
- $730,000 to $759,999: they counter at $775,000. They will counter a second time if the buyer comes up.
- $760,000 or more: they accept.
- Will give a repair credit of up to $5,000.
- Will accept a contingency on the sale of the buyer's home, as long as they can keep showing the house and take another offer with 72 hours' notice.
- A cash offer gets about $10,000 more flexibility on price.
- Happy to leave the pool table and patio furniture to sweeten a deal.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The sellers have countered at $775,000. They've told me they're open to continuing the conversation."
- "They'd like to settle around mid-January, once their new place is ready. If that works for you, it'll help your offer."
- "They're happy to leave the pool table in the games room for the new owners."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- Two bathrooms for six bedrooms. This is the layout, not a defect, but buyers should know.
- One section of the flat roof held water after heavy rain. It was resealed in 2024 with no leaks since.
- Upstairs air conditioning compressor replaced in 2023.
- Hairline settling crack in the garage floor. It is cosmetic.
- Radon tested at completion in 2017, below the action level.
- Lead paint disclosure not needed, built 2017.

listings.description: Modern farmhouse two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with in-ground pool, covered back porch, fire pit, games room and fenced backyard. Rooms: Open-plan living room and kitchen, separate dining room (seats six), sitting room, games room with pool table, upstairs landing lounge. Marble island, farmhouse sink, French-door refrigerator, stainless range, white shaker cabinets. Covered back porch, fire pit with seating, privacy fence, concrete pad beside the garage (room for a shed or trailer), white fence at the front. In-ground, with a stone deck. Whispering Pines, gated.
listings.showingInstructions: Two hours' notice. Lena often stays to answer questions about the house; ask her to step out if the buyer prefers. Hameed meets buyers at the gate.

property.propertyStyle: Single-family detached, modern farmhouse, two storeys
property.otherRooms: Open-plan living room and kitchen, separate dining room (seats six), sitting room, games room with pool table, upstairs landing lounge
property.heating: Natural gas forced air, two zones
property.hoa: $210 per month. Covers the gate, private roads and snow removal.
property.legalDescription: Modern farmhouse two-storey dwelling in Whispering Pines (gated, HOA $210/month) with in-ground pool, covered back porch, fire pit, games room and fenced backyard

ownership.vesting: Jointly, as a married couple (tenants by the entirety)

terms.targetSettlement: Flexible, 45 to 90 days after the agreement
terms.included: Refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer, dryer, pool table, pool loungers, fire pit chairs, TV wall mounts
terms.excluded: Indoor furniture, artwork and TVs, unless the buyer takes the furnished option
terms.homeWarranty: Yes, one year, paid by the sellers
terms.financingAccepted: Any, with a pre-approval letter or proof of funds

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $730,000 unfurnished.
- Under $700,000: they decline.
- $700,000 to $729,999: they counter at $745,000.
- $730,000 or more: they accept.
- Furniture: they would like $35,000 but will take $25,000. They will not sell the furniture piece by piece.
- A furnished offer at $780,000 or more is accepted on the spot.
- Flexible on dates. They will give a buyer up to 90 days to settle.
- No credit for the garage walls or the fence. They say the price allows for it.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The sellers aren't in a rush, so they'll wait for the right offer rather than take a low one."
- "Everything you see can stay. Lena designed the interior herself, and she'd love it to go to someone who'll keep it."
- "They've countered at $745,000. They're flexible on the settlement date if that helps you."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- One full bathroom for four bedrooms, plus a half bathroom downstairs.
- The garage walls are taped drywall that was never painted.
- Pool pump replaced in 2025.
- The back fence stain is fading and will need redoing within a year or two.
- Lead paint disclosure not needed, built 2018.

listings.description: Rooms: Home office, lounge, kitchen, laundry room.

property.otherRooms: Home office, lounge, kitchen, laundry room

lease.dueAtSigning: First month's rent and the security deposit, $3,800 in total
lease.renewal: Either side gives 60 days' notice before the lease ends
lease.utilities: Tenant pays electric, gas and internet. Landlord pays water, sewer and trash.
lease.pets: Cats allowed. Dogs under 40 lb allowed with a $300 pet deposit and $35 per month pet rent.
lease.insurance: Required, with at least $100,000 liability cover
lease.moveInInspection: Walk-through with a signed checklist on move-in day
lease.leasingFee: One month's rent, paid by the landlord
lease.incomeRequirement: At least 3 times the rent ($5,700 per month). A co-signer is acceptable.

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Will drop to $1,850 per month for an 18-month lease. Will not go lower.
- Will waive the application fee for a strong applicant who signs within a week.
- No exceptions on the income requirement without a co-signer.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The landlord asks for first month's rent and a one-month security deposit at signing, so $3,800 in total."
- "If you're open to an 18-month lease, he's willing to bring the rent down to $1,850."
- "He'll need proof of income of about three times the rent, or a co-signer."
confidential.commissionTerms: One month's rent, paid by the landlord

listings.description: Self-service laundromat with wash-and-fold service. Open daily, 6 am to 10 pm.. Equipment: 12 commercial front-load machines (6 washers, 6 dryers) from 2016, folding table, two benches, drinks vending machine, outside security camera.. $2.00 for the first 32 minutes, $0.50 for every 8 minutes after. Coin and card readers on every machine.
listings.showingInstructions: Weekday mornings. Buyers can come in as customers first, then meet Gary in the back room.

terms.included: All 12 machines, coin and card readers, folding table, benches, vending machine, security camera, the name and sign, wash-and-fold customer list, phone number
terms.excluded: Cash in the machines and change safe on settlement day

business.teaser: Self-service laundromat with wash-and-fold service, Fairview
business.whatIsSold: Business only. The unit is leased.
business.buildingSize: About 1,800 sq ft: machine floor, back room and rear corridor to a back exit
business.premisesRent: $2,600 per month, plus water and sewer
business.premisesLeaseEnd: Runs to June 2031, with one 5-year renewal option. Can be transferred to a buyer with the landlord's approval.
business.tradingHistory: Steady. Busiest on weekends and in winter.
business.ownerFinancing: Yes, up to 20% of the price, over three years at 6%
business.included: All 12 machines, coin and card readers, folding table, benches, vending machine, security camera, the name and sign, wash-and-fold customer list, phone number
business.excluded: Cash in the machines and change safe on settlement day
business.licences: No special licences. Local business registration must be updated.
business.training: 2 weeks, including machine maintenance and the wash-and-fold routine
business.nonCompete: Will not open a laundromat within 10 miles for 5 years
business.staffTerms: Buyer is asked to keep Rosa, the attendant

confidential.negotiationRules:
- Lowest price: $135,000.
- Under $125,000: he declines.
- $125,000 to $134,999: he counters at $142,000.
- $135,000 or more: he accepts.
- He will fix the washer seal before settlement at his own cost if asked.
- A buyer who promises to keep Rosa gets the benefit of the doubt on a close offer.
confidential.relayLines:
- "The machines are on card readers as well as coins, so there's very little cash handling."
- "Wash-and-fold brings in about a quarter of the sales, and the customer list comes with the business."
- "He'll finance up to 20% of the price himself over three years."
confidential.disclosureNotes:
- The lease needs the landlord's approval to transfer. The landlord has not been asked yet.
- The machines are from 2016. Commercial machines usually last 15 to 20 years.
- One washer needs a new door seal (about $400). Two dryers have sticky coin slots; the card readers work fine.
- Water and sewer run about $1,400 a month and are already counted in the profit figure.
